cohort: Women with multiple pregnancies who gave birth at the 2nd Clinic of Gynecology and Obstetrics of the Faculty of Medicine (FM), Comenius University (CU) and University Hospital (UH) Bratislava in the years 2010-2022
finding: Primiparity was a significant risk factor for cesarean section, while multiparous women were more likely to have a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women with an acute caesarean section had on average a lower pH of both fetuses compared to vaginal delivery.
